name: Rope
notes: Hemp and manila rope: bridges, hoists, washing lines, nets. Burns like cloth (260 °C, 40 s for a length) so fire can cut a support. Density 650 kg/m³: dry hemp rope floats. Weak to cutting (30 hp). Grippy (0.8) and an easy climb (grade 1). Burns away completely (mw-e03.5), so a burning rope drops what it holds. Soft surface; slash or pierce damage severs it (cuttable), which is how ropes are shot down. (mw-e03.31)
